mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.title, n.summary, n.teacher, n.status, n.view_count, n.download_count, n.favorite_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at, f.original_name, f.size, f.content_type, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, n.uploader_id AS uploader_id FROM note n JOIN note_file f ON f.note_id = n.id JOIN course c ON c.id = n.course_id WHERE n.id = #{id}
SELECT nt.note_id, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name FROM note_tag nt JOIN tag t ON t.id = nt.tag_id WHERE nt.note_id = #{noteId} ORDER BY t.id

SELECT n.id, n.status, n.title, n.view_count, n.download_count, n.favorite_count, n.created_at, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name FROM note n JOIN course c ON c.id = n.course_id WHERE n.uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND n.status != #{excludedStatus} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
SELECT n.uploader_id AS uploader_id, n.status AS status, f.storage_key AS storage_key, f.size, f.content_type AS content_type FROM note n JOIN note_file f ON f.note_id = n.id WHERE n.id = #{id}
SELECT n.id AS note_id, nf.storage_key FROM note n JOIN note_file nf ON nf.note_id = n.id WHERE n.status = #{status} AND nf.is_purged = 0 AND nf.storage_key != '' ORDER BY n.id LIMIT #{limit}
